text:
Lina Gomez: Heads-up — NovusHealth flagged their Mar invoice: a prorated reserved commit plus a large burst line. They say commit change was admin-requested and shouldn't be prorated.
Oliver Park: I pulled the account audit: change_request CR-4021 submitted 2026-03-08 05:12 UTC, rep approved at 05:15 UTC. System decommit logged at 05:14:10 and re-reserve at 05:16:40 (race).
Samira Khan: can we treat this as a transfer per intra-org transfer policy? If so, reverse prorate and reclassify. Need artifacts (ticket, email, logs) to create adjustment.
Lina Gomez: attaching excerpt from invoice: 
```
Line 12: Reserved commit - NovusHealth - 1.2 GPU-month -> billed 1.2 for Mar16-31 = $14,400
Line 13: Prorate credit - decommit 0.5 (Mar1-15) = -$2,250
Line 40: Burst overage - Mar8 05:14-06:20 = 9.2 hrs = $1,104
Total: $13,254
```
Oliver Park: autoscale snippet: 
```
2026-03-08T05:14:10Z autoscale: pool-decommit id=pool-nova-9 reason=rebalance
2026-03-08T05:15:01Z user-request: CR-4021 submitted
2026-03-08T05:15:15Z account-action: Oliver Park approve CR-4021
2026-03-08T05:16:40Z autoscale: pool-reserve id=pool-nova-9 reason=rebalance
```
Samira Khan: that's clear evidence. Propose ADJ-2026-4675 to reverse prorate and convert to transfer; also re-evaluate burst hours — looks like ~6 of 9.2 hrs were forced due to failover. Recommend waiving 6 hrs (~$720) and reversing prorate (-$2,250) resulting net credit ~$1,866.
Lina Gomez: please create ADJ-2026-4675 and attach SUP-6480, change email, and autoscale logs. Mark discretionary > $1,000 for finance lead approval.
billing-bot: Adjustment request ADJ-2026-4675 created. Artifacts: SUP-6480, novus-change-email.pdf, autoscale-03-08.log. Status: pending_finance_lead_review.
Oliver Park: I'll add account notes and confirm approval timestamp (05:15:15 UTC).
Samira Khan: finance lead approval needed — @billing-bot flag for exec review.
billing-bot: ADJ-2026-4675 flagged for finance_lead.
Lina Gomez: once approved, schedule credit for Apr run and draft customer message offering credit and brief apology.
Oliver Park: will coordinate comms after approval.
Samira Khan: side action: file GH issue to add 10-minute debounce between manual commit edits and autoscaler actions to prevent race.
Lina Gomez: agreed. closing loop here pending lead sign-off.
